s: The rapid development and adoption of artificial intelligence technologies ("AI") further exacerbates these concerns, as AI can be used to both enhance the capabilities of attackers and help defenders develop more advanced security measures.
We expect that the sophistication of cyber-threats will continue to evolve as threat actors increase their use of AI and machine-learning technologies.
